h: Temple row widens: Deepinder Goyal denies paid promotion, Ranveer Allahbadia says he is not an investor in the ₹85,000 wearable
k: The fight over Goyal's brain-blood-flow wearable has moved from science to influencer disclosures, with liver specialist 'TheLiverDoc' asking who is backing it and why.

h: Anthropic sets IPO price at $70–78 a share, valuing the Claude maker at up to $1.4 trillion
k: An updated filing on 10 November puts 825 million shares on offer, with Nasdaq trading under the ticker 'ANT' expected around 19 November.

h: Kalyan Jewellers' Q2 profit jumps 64% to ₹427 crore as revenue crosses ₹10,000 crore
k: The jeweller's September quarter beat estimates, though a one-time land sale added about ₹73 crore to the profit.

h: Ramayana: Part 1 crosses ₹823 crore worldwide in six days and becomes the first Indian film to top the UK box office
k: Sacnilk puts the India net total at ₹440 crore after a ₹94 crore Tuesday, while the film set overseas records for an Indian release.

h: Blue Tokai crosses ₹500 crore in revenue, but its loss widens 54% to ₹83 crore
k: The coffee chain's sales jumped nearly 60% in FY26 as it opened more cafés, but costs grew even faster.

h: SoftBank swings to a $7 billion loss, but Lenskart and Meesho add $394 million in gains as Ola Electric slips
k: SoftBank's first quarterly loss in about two years came from US data-centre costs, while two of its Indian bets kept climbing.

h: ShareChat parent crosses ₹1,000 crore in revenue as microdrama app QuickTV takes off
k: Mohalla Tech's FY26 revenue grew about 40%, and it says it turned EBITDA-positive in the June quarter.

h: Matrimony.com's Q2 profit rises 2.7 times to ₹20.7 crore; it will also buy more of astrology matchmaker Astro-Vision
k: The matchmaking company added 3.02 lakh paid subscriptions in the quarter, up about 27% from a year ago.

h: SEBI clears MakeMyTrip's India IPO; the share sale could raise over $1 billion
k: The Nasdaq-listed travel company will sell part of its Indian unit to local investors, but the unit gets no new money.

h: D2C brands bagged one in three startup funding deals in October, led by Boldfit's $42 million
k: Even as overall startup funding fell to $678 million, consumer brands raised about $200 million ahead of the festive and wedding season.

h: October retail inflation may have crossed RBI's 6% ceiling, economists say; official data due Thursday
k: Polls point to a reading of about 6%, up from 5.5% in September, as food costs climb. The official number comes out on 12 November.

h: India's unemployment rate eases to 5.1% in July–September, government survey shows
k: Joblessness for people aged 15 and over fell from 5.4% in the April–June quarter, helped by a drop in rural unemployment.

h: Sheikh Hasina's lawyers seek a new Bangladeshi passport; Dhaka says no and repeats its extradition demand
k: The former PM, who has lived in India since August 2024, has said she wants to return home in December. Bangladesh says she must come back through extradition.

h: Govt extends ₹2,700 crore PLI scheme for medical devices to 2035–36 and invites new applications
k: Manufacturers will get three years to set up factories, and the minimum sales level needed to claim incentives has been dropped.

h: Delhi gets a river cruise on the Yamuna: 40-minute rides between Sonia Vihar and Jagatpur for ₹500
k: Union minister Sarbananda Sonowal launched the service on 10 November with Delhi CM Rekha Gupta.

h: COP31 leaders' summit opens in Antalya today, with about 102 heads of state and government expected
k: Leaders will set out their national climate plans on 11–12 November. PM Modi is not expected to attend; Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav leads India's team.

h: Russia and Ukraine agree to a large prisoner swap on day one of US-led Abu Dhabi talks; up to 1,500 each discussed
k: In their first US-brokered talks since February, the two sides spoke for nearly four hours. Zelenskyy called the session 'constructive'. A second day of talks is under way.

h: Trump says the Iran war is 'effectively over', but keeps the naval blockade; Brent briefly dips below $90
k: Iran called the remarks 'fake news' and says it will not talk until its seven conditions are met. Oil fell as traders bet the fighting is winding down.

h: China's trade surplus passes $1 trillion for the second year running, with two months still to go
k: October exports jumped 35.2% from a year earlier, driven by demand for AI and data-centre equipment.

h: Markets reopen after the Diwali break with GIFT Nifty up 297 points; foreign investors have put in ₹53,739 crore this month
k: November's foreign buying is the biggest monthly total since September 2024. Lower oil prices are also helping.

h: Wall Street slips after US prices rise 0.4% in October; markets now fully expect a Fed rate hike in December
k: The Nasdaq fell about 0.7% and the S&P 500 about 0.4% as inflation came in above forecasts. Nvidia dropped about 5.5%.

h: Anthropic takes on Microsoft and Google with Claude Sheets, Whiteboards and Meetings
k: Claude can now build spreadsheets, sketch plans on shared boards and sit in on Google Meet calls, days before Anthropic's IPO.

h: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, its 'strongest model', to AI Ultra users and developers at $2 per million tokens
k: After a limited preview for cyber defenders in October, Carbon is now in the Gemini app, AI Mode in Search and the API.

h: OpenAI launches 'Businesses in ChatGPT': brands can claim verified profiles and run their own agents
k: Companies get a blue tick, a dashboard showing how often ChatGPT mentions them, and, in the US, a customer-service agent inside ChatGPT.

h: Google's Pixel Tag, its answer to the AirTag, goes on sale today; India price ₹3,799
k: The Bluetooth tracker costs $29 in the US, and a four-pack is ₹12,900 in India.

h: Rain washes out 3rd ODI in Hamilton: India can't lose the series now; Shreyas Iyer to lead in the last two games
k: Not a ball was bowled at Seddon Park on 10 November, so India stay 2-0 up and New Zealand's 11-series home winning run is over.

h: Manu Bhaker, Esha Singh and Divya Subbaraju win 25m pistol team gold at the shooting World Championship in Doha
k: The trio scored 1761 to beat South Korea by 13 points, India's second gold of the championship; the men's 50m rifle 3-positions team added bronze.

h: FIFPRO World 11: Messi returns for a record 18th time, Yamal makes history, Ballon d'Or winner Kane left out
k: Nearly 20,000 professional footballers voted for the 2026 men's team of the year, announced on 9 November.

h: OTT this week: Rings of Power Season 3, Kareena's Daayra on Netflix, and Bengali thriller Mrigaya 1.5
k: Prime Video has The Rings of Power today and Jailer 2 tomorrow; Friday brings Daayra, Student of the Year: After Dark and Mrigaya 1.5.

h: Suriya's Scene crosses ₹100 crore India gross in five days, ₹174 crore worldwide
k: Jithu Madhavan's Diwali action comedy is Suriya's third hit of 2026, after Karuppu and Vishwanath & Sons.

h: 33 Sundarbans villagers, including 10 women, train to keep people and tigers safe
k: The new volunteers join a network of 98 'first responders' in Kultali, South 24 Parganas, who step in when a tiger strays into a village.

h: India's Dr Reddy's wins first US FDA nod for a $40-a-year generic HIV-prevention shot
k: The Hyderabad drugmaker's version of lenacapavir, an injection given just twice a year, is meant for 120 low- and middle-income countries.

h: An Assam father and daughter turn rhino and elephant dung into notebooks
k: Since 2014, their venture Elrhino has made paper products from wildlife waste, giving villagers near habitats an extra income.

h: From 27 sewing machines to steady factory jobs: Aarey's Warli women are earning with PF and medical cover
k: Adivasi women from Mumbai's Aarey forest, whose hamlets shrank after the Metro car-shed project, now draw regular salaries at an Andheri factory.

h: Mumbai doctors give a 6-kg baby a new liver in a 10-hour surgery, with his mother as donor
k: The one-year-old had advanced liver disease from a rare genetic disorder; he went home after 15 days.

h: 300+ volunteers on foot and horseback find a 6-year-old boy with autism safe after 2 nights in Kentucky woods
k: Roman Heilman walked out of the brush with his dog onto a horse trail, about a mile and a half from home.

h: The world's driest desert bursts into its biggest bloom in 30 years, with 200+ species in flower
k: Record rains brought by a strong El Niño woke seeds and bulbs that had slept in Chile's Atacama sand for decades.

h: Newborn deaths in Flint fell by half after families got cash during pregnancy and infancy
k: A study in JAMA Pediatrics links the Rx Kids programme to a sharp drop in babies dying in their first month.

h: One of Australia's most mysterious bats turns up 400 miles from where it was last seen
k: A scientist's handheld detector picked up the call of the rare Arnhem sheath-tailed bat at a Northern Territory sanctuary.

h: Deepinder Goyal hits back at critics of his ₹85,000 Temple wearable: 'We didn't make any medical claim'
k: The Zomato founder says Temple is a fitness and AI device, not a medical one, and that he expects no more than 1% of its sales to come from India.

h: Jio launches a ₹10,000 recharge plan that lasts three years, with unlimited 5G and Canva Pro Lite
k: Pay once and your Jio number is covered for 1,095 days, which works out to about ₹278 a month.

h: Nvidia stock hits a multi-month low as CEO Jensen Huang admits an affair and the board opens a probe
k: Shares fell about 4% on Monday to $178.44 after the board began an independent inquiry into whether Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort.

h: PhysicsWallah's Q2 profit doubles to ₹142 crore; management says AI now writes about 90% of its code
k: Revenue rose 18% to ₹1,242 crore, even as headcount and employee costs came down.

h: Airtel reportedly offers a buy-1-get-1 recharge on its ₹349 and ₹399 plans, after Jio's similar deal
k: An eligible account could get a second recharge of the same value free, stretching 28 days to 56.

h: Anthropic reportedly plans to set its IPO valuation range this week, with trading as early as next Thursday
k: Some investors want a valuation below the $1.5 trillion target discussed last week, per the Wall Street Journal.

h: Anthropic releases Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2: input price cut to $8 per million tokens and about 30% faster
k: The launch comes with a METR report suggesting Anthropic's own models may be speeding up its AI research.

h: Apple launches $49.99 'Intelligence Usage Packs', its first paid Apple Intelligence option
k: For now the packs work only in Logic Pro, with other Creator Studio apps to follow.

h: Adobe and Disney announce a multi-year AI alliance to build custom Firefly models
k: Adobe becomes an official AI innovation partner of Disney, which will work on generative models tailored to its own characters and worlds.

h: World Bank warns governments: digital ID wallets must not become a must-have for essential services
k: Its new report says elderly, low-income and low-connectivity people risk being locked out.

h: IIT Madras alumni's Discovered Materials offers a $1 million prize for five unsolved materials-science problems
k: The Y Combinator-backed startup wants to test whether AI can truly make scientific progress.

h: Apple Pay in India: HSBC reportedly in talks to become the second bank partner
k: Banks are negotiating over how much interchange income Apple gets on each credit card transaction.

h: Government caps trade margins on 137 anti-cancer drugs; steepest price cut is 96%
k: The cap of 30% on trade margins took effect on 9 November and is expected to save about ₹3,557 crore a year.

h: E20 petrol row: Karnataka claims ethanol above the limit; Petroleum Ministry says all 893 samples were within range
k: Kerala has begun random checks at petrol pumps, and oil companies want joint sampling.

h: Punjab records 1,152 fresh farm fires on Diwali, its sharpest single-day rise this season
k: The season's tally reached 4,459, and Sangrur had the most new fires that day.

h: Mumbai gets its first non-AC local train with automatic doors, now in safety trials
k: The 12-coach rake from Chennai's ICF has louvred doors and sensors that reopen if someone is blocking them.

h: Indian Railways earns ₹628 crore from scrap sales in October, beating its ₹600 crore target
k: The month-long cleanliness drive also freed up about 6.2 lakh square feet of space.

h: Gold fell 21% globally this year but only 15% in India; rupee and import duty cushioned the drop
k: From 30 January to 30 October, dollar gold fell 21.4% while rupee gold fell 14.9%, says an Axis Mutual Fund report.

h: PM Modi speaks with Zelenskyy, says India is ready to contribute to a peaceful settlement
k: The call on 9 November came ahead of US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi.

h: After midterm win, US Democrats say they will probe Elon Musk and Stephen Miller from January
k: House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries says he is 'a hard yes' on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

h: Global fossil CO₂ emissions projected to fall 0.41% in 2026, but total emissions may still hit a record
k: The Global Carbon Budget projects fossil emissions of 38.24 billion tonnes, while land-use emissions climb.

h: Sensex ends 107 points higher at 81,106, Nifty at 25,044; markets are shut today for Balipratipada
k: NSE and BSE reopen on Wednesday, 11 November, with normal hours.

h: HSBC upgrades India to 'Overweight'; Citi raises its Nifty target to 28,000 from 26,000
k: Both brokerages point to resilient earnings and a rotation of money away from AI-heavy markets.

h: India beat New Zealand by 4 runs (DLS) in the second ODI to go 2-0 up in the five-match series
k: Rain stopped play in Wellington with India on 113 for 7, needing 22 more from 66 balls.

h: Mohammed Shami retires from Test cricket after a 13-year career
k: The fast bowler will continue to play limited-overs cricket for India.

h: Smriti Mandhana named captain in all three formats for India women's South Africa tour
k: The December tour has one Test, three ODIs and three T20Is.

h: Teen star Vaibhav Sooryavanshi adds a Tata Sierra to his car collection after IPL 2026 award
k: The 15-year-old won Super Striker of the Season with a strike rate of 237.50.

h: Anuj Shrivatri becomes India's 100th chess Grandmaster
k: The Madhya Pradesh player won the ASEAN Plus Individual Open in the Philippines to earn the title.

h: Jailer 2 becomes the highest-grossing Tamil film in Tamil Nadu with ₹217.75 crore; OTT debut on 12 November
k: It edged past Vijay's The GOAT (₹217.25 crore) on Day 26 and has grossed ₹827 crore worldwide.

h: Delhi High Court grants Amitabh Bachchan a permanent injunction protecting his name, image and voice
k: The order covers unauthorised commercial use, including a 'video call' app and a fake KBC lottery.

h: Bengaluru's HRS Navigation built an affordable surgical 'GPS' now used in 200+ hospitals
k: Its easyNav system helps surgeons plan and track procedures, and it avoids recurring per-surgery consumable costs.

h: FarmerChat, a free AI assistant for farmers, has served over a million users across India
k: A Varanasi nursery owner used it to control disease in 4 acres of mango saplings and estimates he saved about ₹10,000.

h: A New Jersey teen taught himself machine learning and built Kora, a free app that helps families read autistic children's cues
k: It has more than 700 users in 12 countries, mostly through autism therapy centres.

h: Fish stocks thrive in Scotland's Summer Isles after a 10-year scallop-dredging ban protected rare maerl beds
k: The protected area of about 150,000 acres holds all of the region's maerl, a seaweed that fish breed among.

h: Glowworms are set to return to a North Yorkshire reserve after about 100 years, thanks to a volunteer's garden shed
k: Around 1,900 larvae reared by Peter Cooper are due for release at Nosterfield Nature Reserve this year.

h: New Jersey students fill a football field with more than 250,000 pounds of food for families in need
k: It was the largest food drive in the history of the nonprofit Dermer Dreams.

h: The globe skimmer dragonfly, under 1 gram, may fly up to 1,000 km across the Indian Ocean every year
k: Scientists think it rides monsoon winds from southern India to the Maldives, though the full route is still a hypothesis.

h: Zomato's 'Limitless Delivery' lets you order from restaurants up to 40 km away in 7 cities
k: Zomato (Eternal) has switched on a feature that stretches delivery range to as far as 40 km within a city, so restaurants that were out of reach can now show up on your app.

h: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production in Texas by mid-2027, Musk says
k: Elon Musk says Tesla will free up its Texas factory space for the Cybercab robotaxi, ending production of the stainless-steel pickup next year.

h: Maharashtra FDA suspends food licences of 105 outlets, including Blinkit and Zepto units in Mumbai
k: A pre-Diwali inspection drive on 4 and 5 November found hygiene lapses across the state. The suspension list names Blink Commerce Pvt Ltd and Zepto Ltd, both in Mumbai.

h: OpenAI reportedly closes $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, below the $1.4 trillion it first sought
k: Bloomberg reports that the ChatGPT maker has received the first part of a new round, with SoftBank and MGX among the investors, after the AI-stock sell-off forced it to scale back.

h: Mamaearth parent Honasa's Q2 profit jumps 87% to ₹73 crore as revenue grows 36%
k: Honasa Consumer posted a profit of about ₹73 crore for July–September, up from about ₹39 crore a year ago, though profit and revenue slipped from the June quarter.

h: Angel One overtakes Zerodha as India's No. 2 broker with 69.98 lakh active clients
k: NSE data for October shows Angel One adding 2.43 lakh active clients while Zerodha lost 32,435, flipping the order behind Groww.

h: MakeMyTrip buys a majority stake in ride-pooling app Quick Ride
k: The travel giant enters shared mobility for an undisclosed sum. Quick Ride's pooling business moves into a new company with its promoters still running it.

h: EloElo raises $80 million from Hornbill and NBCUniversal to take microdrama app Story TV global
k: The Bengaluru group behind Story TV says the Series C takes its total funding to $130 million.

h: Jewellery brand GIVA raises over $100 million (about ₹975 crore) led by Multiples
k: The Bengaluru brand plans to grow from 400-plus stores to over 1,000 outlets in three to five years.

h: Shiprocket swings to a profit in Q2 as revenue rises 35% to ₹674 crore
k: The logistics-tech firm made about ₹60 lakh in profit against a ₹20.3 crore loss a year ago, and is now debt-free after its IPO.

h: Cabinet approves ₹2,814 crore scheme to boost lithium and nickel processing in India
k: A 30% capital subsidy will back four processing plants as the government tries to cut its dependence on imported refined minerals.

h: Money deadlines this month: ITR date for audit cases is 21 Nov, pensioners have until 30 Nov
k: A quick list of what changed from 1 November, from tax filing dates to credit card fees at one public-sector bank.

h: Iran's Guards say tankers hit mines near Hormuz; Brent slips below $100 as talks continue
k: Maritime officials have not confirmed the Guards' claims, while mediators work on a US-Iran proposal.

h: US to mediate Russia–Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi on 10–11 November, with low hopes
k: The working-level round is the first direct negotiation between the two sides in about nine months.

h: COP31 opens in Antalya, Türkiye: nearly 200 countries, leaders' summit on 11–12 November
k: The UN climate summit runs to 20 November, with the 1.5°C goal under heavy pressure.

h: US midterms: Democrats win both the House and the Senate, networks call
k: Counts are still being finalised. AP tallies cited by Yahoo News show Democrats around 254 House seats and 54 Senate seats.

h: IndiaAI Mission releases three homegrown models: EKA-1 and Dhīr 2B and 5B
k: EKA-1 from Soket Labs covers all 22 scheduled Indian languages; ZenteiQ's two smaller Dhīr models are open source.

h: Apple CEO John Ternus is pushing software chief Craig Federighi to speed up AI, Bloomberg reports
k: Mark Gurman says Ternus is frustrated that Apple seems less urgent about AI than its rivals.

h: Muhurat trading ends in the red for the first time in nine years: Sensex 80,999, Nifty 24,986
k: The one-hour Diwali session on Sunday followed a seven-day rally; smallcaps bucked the trend.

h: Bosch approves a 1:5 split and a 3:1 bonus, so every share becomes 20
k: The board announced the two moves with its Q2 results on 6 November; both need shareholder approval.

h: Norris wins a wet Brazilian GP after Antonelli spins from the lead; Mercedes clinch constructors' title
k: Verstappen was second and Hadjar third. Antonelli's lead over Verstappen is 111 points with 75 left.

h: Man Utd come from two down twice to draw 4-4 with Aston Villa as Dorgu levels in the 96th minute
k: United are still in the relegation zone on 8 points from 10 games.

h: Chennai Open final between Janice Tjen and Magda Linette moved to Monday after rain and poor air
k: Top seed and defending champion Tjen faces Linette at 11 a.m. today.

h: ECB braces for a loss of up to £50 million in 2027 with no India series at home
k: Even with the Ashes at home, the board expects a big swing from the £12.6 million profit it made in 2025.

h: Ramayana: Part 1's Diwali weekend: trackers put it at ₹220–239 crore net in India, ₹500 crore worldwide
k: Early day-4 estimates vary widely, from about ₹37 crore to ₹56 crore net.

h: OTT this week: Haiwaan, Blind Game, Dilwali Diwali and I'm Game, with Student Of The Year: After Dark next
k: A quick list of what streamed over Diwali week, per listings.

h: Manisha Bhanwala becomes India's first woman world wrestling champion, winning 59 kg gold in Astana
k: She came back from 6-0 down to beat the USA's Abigail Nette 8-6 in the final on 30 October.

h: Barbados is certified by WHO for eliminating mother-to-child HIV transmission
k: Babies born from 2022 to 2024 had no new HIV infections from their mothers, an independent review found.

h: IIT Kharagpur student wins ₹5 lakh Viasat Space for Good India Challenge for AI to dodge space debris
k: Adeetya Uppal's idea helps satellites detect threatening debris and plan avoidance moves in seconds.

h: A family Doberman helped save a baby: her behaviour led to a heart-condition diagnosis
k: Doctors found baby Alexander's heart rate was 280 beats per minute.

h: Volunteer dog teams find invasive plants with 75% accuracy in a German study
k: Eleven of 12 teams passed the field test, giving a low-cost way to protect local ecosystems.

h: UN report: 252 million hectares of habitat are being actively restored across 149 countries
k: The Green Climate Fund also had a record year, allocating $3.3 billion to developing countries.

h: A beetle absent from Wales for about 60 years has been rediscovered in Pembrokeshire
k: Surveyors found short-necked oil beetle larvae at Castlemartin Range after spotting adults there in 2025.

h: Coca-Cola's Indian bottling parent files IPO papers; Thums Up and Maaza maker's revenue up 20%
k: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings has filed draft papers with SEBI for a share sale of up to about 99.7 crore shares. Coca-Cola's stake would fall from 60% to roughly 45%.

h: Swiggy renames itself 'Sweety' for Diwali, down to the delivery bags
k: For the festive season the food-delivery brand has swapped its name on hoardings, rider jerseys, bags and social handles to celebrate India's love of mithai.

h: Meesho closes its ₹186.71 crore Kirana Club deal, adding 4.1 million kirana shops
k: The e-commerce company now owns 92.74% of the kirana-network app and its Indian arm, as it pushes into business-to-business trade outside the big cities.

h: Ramayana: Part One crosses ₹200 crore gross in India in three days
k: Nitesh Tiwari's Diwali release, starring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, is at ₹208 crore gross after its first weekend day, though Hindi screens are running at only 35% full.

h: 10 years after demonetisation, cash in circulation is at a record ₹43.46 lakh crore
k: The 8 November 2016 note ban was meant to curb black money and push digital payments. UPI exploded, but India's cash habit survived.

h: DeepMind's AI agents find two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
k: Google DeepMind says human-guided AI agents cut the theoretical cost of forging some RSA signatures by about 1,600x. Modern 2048-bit keys are not affected.

h: OYO parent PRISM posts ₹353 crore Q1 profit, but ₹244 crore is a tax credit
k: Revenue rose 35% to ₹2,814 crore, yet most of the profit growth comes from a one-off deferred tax credit rather than cash from hotels.

h: New-age scorecard: Nykaa profit jumps 207%, Lenskart doubles, Swiggy's loss narrows
k: Three consumer-internet names reported July–September results. Two are solidly profitable now, while Swiggy is still losing money but less than last year.

h: Delhi's air hits AQI 369 on Diwali eve, with 'severe' forecast for today and tomorrow
k: Sixteen of 59 monitoring stations were already in the severe band on Saturday, and experts warn some could cross 450 after tonight's fireworks.

h: Agniveers get two more years: Cabinet clears a 'second tour of duty'
k: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh said willing Agniveers can stay on and be enrolled as regular soldiers after four or six years if they meet selection criteria.

h: Peppermint Robotics raises ₹100 crore to scale robots worldwide
k: The Pune and Austin-based startup closed a pre-Series B led by pi Ventures and Crane Venture Partners, roughly $10.5 million.

h: Starlink India still hasn't launched, and the ₹8,600 price was test data
k: Despite its licence and a Jio distribution deal, Starlink was not taking consumer orders in India as of 6 November.

h: LPG check for November: commercial cylinder up ₹10, home cylinder unchanged at ₹942
k: Petrol and diesel prices are also unchanged, while jet fuel went up ₹1.30 a litre.

h: Axon invests $1.2 billion in drone maker Skydio at a $5.2 billion valuation
k: Only $255 million is fresh capital; the rest buys existing shares. Axon becomes Skydio's exclusive public-safety distributor in the US and Canada.

h: US sets up Task Force Iron Gate to extend its Iran blockade to land routes
k: CENTCOM also disabled another commercial ship in the Gulf of Oman, the 11th since the naval blockade began in July.

h: Wall Street ends its worst week in over a year, even after a Friday bounce
k: The S&P 500 fell 2.7% for the week and the Nasdaq logged a fourth straight weekly loss, as AI stocks sold off before a partial rebound.

h: Reliance jumps 8% on record Q2; Jio Platforms trades 28% above IPO price
k: Shares rose on 2 November after Reliance posted record quarterly revenue, EBITDA and profit, taking its market value above ₹17 lakh crore.

h: CarTrade leads new-age stocks, up 23% in a week as 54 of 69 tracked names gain
k: Foreign buying, Q2 earnings and lower crude helped the Inc42 basket, while the Nifty Midcap 100 rose 5.8%.

h: India win rain-hit 2nd ODI by 4 runs (DLS) to lead New Zealand 2-0
k: Gurnoor Brar took a career-best 4/30 in Wellington as New Zealand were bowled out for about 134 chasing a revised target.

h: Dhinidhi Desinghu becomes the first Indian with two Youth Olympics medals
k: She took bronze in the 200m freestyle in Dakar, while Tirthank Pegu won bronze in the 200m butterfly. India's tally is now six.

h: Chennaiyin FC thrash defending champions East Bengal 5-3 in ISL goal-fest
k: Brison Fernandes scored twice in the first 18 minutes and Irfan Yadwad added two more after the break.

h: Leeds beat Tottenham 1-0 with a late Noah Okafor goal
k: The substitute's goal ended Spurs' winning run in Saturday's Premier League action.

h: Suriya's Scene earns ₹81.5 crore worldwide in two days
k: The Diwali action-comedy added ₹20.25 crore net in India on Saturday, up 5.7% on opening day.

h: Godzilla Minus Zero heads for a record $32 million US opening
k: It would be the biggest ever US opening for a live-action foreign-language film, ahead of The Cat in the Hat.

h: A venomous primate feared extinct for a century is alive in Indonesia
k: The Bangka slow loris, last recorded in the 1930s, has been found again, thanks largely to a rescue centre's records.

h: 25,000 people from 50 countries help buy a 9,400-acre estate for wildlife
k: The Wildlife Trusts raised about £30 million to protect Rothbury Estate in Northumberland, home to a Bronze Age hill fort.

h: After a failed first crop, a 57-year-old grew soil-free strawberries and sold ₹44 lakh
k: Ketan Sodha, a Mumbai commerce graduate with no farming background, now grows strawberries year-round in Mahabaleshwar.

h: A 100-year-old peepal was lifted by a 50-tonne crane and replanted, and it's growing
k: Tree-transplantation expert Bharat Sisodia saved an Ahmedabad peepal after it was cut down, moving it nearly two kilometres.

h: A Delhi fellowship pays rural performers a stipend to learn theatre
k: Bargad's six-month programme pays ₹10,000 a month, rising to ₹15,000 from January 2027, funded by individual donors.

h: After 28 years and 31,000 miles on foot, Karl Bushby is home in Hull
k: The former paratrooper reached home on 2 November and hugged his mother, Angela, at her gate.

h: Angel One overtakes Zerodha to become India's No. 2 broker
k: New NSE data for October puts Angel One ahead of Zerodha by active clients for the first time. Groww is still far ahead at No. 1.

h: Remember Karbonn? It's back with a ₹11,999 phone and a 7,000mAh battery
k: The Indian phone brand that ruled budget shelves a decade ago has returned with the Rebel series, betting on battery life over 5G.

h: Ramayana crosses ₹100 crore in India in just two days
k: Nitesh Tiwari's mega-budget epic has earned about ₹112.9 crore net in India and roughly ₹220 crore worldwide since Thursday's release.

h: Mamaearth's parent Honasa grows profit 87% to ₹73 crore
k: The D2C beauty company behind Mamaearth posted strong September-quarter numbers, with revenue up 36%.

h: OpenAI raises $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
k: Bloomberg reports the ChatGPT maker's round could reach about $20 billion — but at a lower price than it was aiming for in September.

h: Harsh Jain teases a 'brand new Dream11' by end-December
k: After the real-money gaming ban killed its paid contests, Dream11's CEO says a rebuilt app for sports fans is coming.

h: ED searches CoinDCX and Delta Exchange over crypto trades sent abroad
k: The Enforcement Directorate says the two exchanges allegedly routed crypto derivatives and tokenised stock trades overseas without permission. Delta denies it.

h: Burger King India launches a black-bun 'Doomsday Whopper' for Avengers
k: As Marvel's official restaurant partner in India, Burger King has rolled out a villain-themed menu from ₹199 ahead of the film's December release.

h: Sensex jumps 1,718 points as foreign money pours back into India
k: The Sensex and Nifty rose about 2% on Friday and over 8% for the week — their best week in six years.

h: India beat Japan 4-1 to win a record 6th Asian Champions Trophy
k: Down 0-1 for most of the final, India scored four goals in the last 18 minutes in Mohali to complete a hat-trick of titles.

h: Minister says voter ID, not Aadhaar, may be used for benefit payments
k: Union Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh said biometrics and the voter ID number would be the basis for paying beneficiaries. No official policy has been announced yet.

h: 67 Israeli MPs back Eisenkot over Netanyahu to form the next government
k: President Herzog will announce on Sunday who gets the first chance to form a government after last month's election.

h: MakeMyTrip buys majority stake in carpooling app Quick Ride
k: The travel giant is entering daily commutes, adding Bengaluru's Quick Ride to a ground-transport stable that already has redBus and Savaari.

h: Claude can now read your bank transactions and flag odd charges
k: Anthropic's new Personal Finance beta connects bank and card accounts through Plaid. It's US-only for now and read-only.

h: Jewellery brand GIVA raises $100 million to open 1,000 stores
k: The fine-jewellery startup's round is led by Multiples, just as India heads into Diwali shopping.

h: US economy adds 165,000 jobs in October, far above forecasts
k: Unemployment fell to 4.1%, a surprise after a rough week for US stocks.

h: NSE shares hit a record; exchange now worth over $50 billion
k: India's biggest stock exchange touched ₹1,953.95 a share after strong September-quarter profits.

h: Tata Punch EV beats Mahindra XEV 9S by just 45 units in October
k: India's best-selling electric car race is down to a photo finish, with EV sales up about 76% from last year.

h: Turkey ratifies a NATO-style defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan
k: The Mecca agreement commits the three countries to help each other if one is attacked.

h: EloElo raises $80 million from NBCUniversal to grow microdramas
k: The parent of Story TV is betting that Indians will pay for bite-sized vertical dramas.

h: India hold off Pakistan 3-2 in SAFF Championship opener
k: Suhail Bhat scored twice as the defending champions led 3-0 at half-time in Dhaka, before two late Pakistan goals.

h: Bengaluru startup Aina unveils a $399 AI ring with its own screen
k: The ring tries to guess your next three actions and lets you approve them with a flick.

h: Bank of India waives processing fees on home and car loans till March 2027
k: Borrowers with a CIBIL score of 725 or more can skip the fee; EV car loans qualify regardless of score.

h: Paraguay's president tries to resign after a digital bank collapses
k: Congress refused Santiago Peña's resignation and moved towards impeachment after Ueno, used by about 3 million people, failed.

h: Cabinet clears ₹2,814 crore to build lithium and nickel plants in India
k: The scheme gives a 30% capital subsidy for four processing plants to cut dependence on imports for EV batteries.

h: 15-year-old Tanvi Patri wins India's first Youth Olympics women's singles silver
k: She pushed world junior champion Zhang Yi Xin to 26-24 in the deciding game of the final in Dakar.

h: US Justice Department sets up a 'Super Intelligence' task force
k: The new team will go after foreign states, criminal groups and fraudsters who misuse advanced AI.

h: MobiKwik gets an RBI lending licence, eyes ₹5,000 crore in loans
k: The fintech's subsidiary can now lend directly as an NBFC, starting within three to six months.

h: India go for 2-0 against New Zealand in today's 2nd ODI
k: After Virat Kohli's 74 sealed the rain-hit opener, the series moves to Wellington.

h: Diwali weekend on OTT: Haiwaan, The Vvaan and Last Man in Tower
k: Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, Sidharth Malhotra and Manoj Bajpayee lead this weekend's streaming picks.

h: Seabird colony wiped out by bird flu bounces back to 756 terns
k: At England's Pagham Harbour, sandwich terns have returned in big numbers after vanishing in 2022.

h: These Tamil Nadu villages skip Diwali crackers every year — to protect bats
k: In villages across the state, people have chosen quiet Diwalis for generations so fruit bats roosting nearby aren't scared away.

h: Critically endangered pangolin caught on camera near Shillong
k: A Wildlife Institute of India camera trap recorded a Chinese pangolin in forests on the edge of the city.

h: Brazil expands Pantanal park, home to the world's most jaguars
k: The protected area in the world's largest tropical wetland has grown by 185 square miles.

h: Barbados stops HIV passing from mothers to babies, WHO confirms
k: No baby in Barbados got HIV from their mother between 2022 and 2024.

h: This Maharashtra village now makes 500 litres of drinking water from air
k: A machine built with CSIR-IICT scientists pulls moisture out of the air for children in drought-prone Washim.

h: Nature is being restored at the fastest rate ever recorded, says UN
k: About 252 million hectares across 149 countries are now under active restoration, a UNEP report finds.

h: A Gurugram student built a free app that measures light pollution from a phone photo
k: Class 12 student Suhani Gupta's SkyQi has collected readings from 490+ people in 63 countries.

h: Blinkit Ambulance will now charge ₹2,500 for non-emergency trips
k: Emergency rides stay free. Routine trips like check-ups and hospital-to-home transfers will now be paid.

h: Deepinder Goyal hits back at doctors over his ‘Temple’ wearable
k: Doctors called the ₹85,000 brain-tracking gadget a scam. Goyal says the science will prove them wrong.

h: OpenAI could go public in 2027
k: The ChatGPT maker's president says the company could be ready for a stock market listing next year.

h: A viral video got a PVR juice counter shut in Bengaluru
k: A moviegoer alleged that used cups were being reused. Food safety officials inspected — and shut the counter.

h: India set for a ₹1 lakh crore Dhanteras
k: Traders expect record shopping today — led by gold and silver, even though gold is about 20% costlier than last year.

h: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
k: After 23 years and a record 146 goals, the 41-year-old is done playing for Portugal — but he isn't leaving Al-Nassr.

h: Democrats win both houses of the US Congress
k: In Tuesday's midterm elections, Democrats took control of the House and the Senate — the first time in 20 years a Republican president has lost both.

h: Wall Street loses $2.5 trillion in a single day
k: The Nasdaq fell 5.5%, its worst day since April 2025, as AI and chip stocks crashed.

h: Tankers catch fire in the Strait of Hormuz
k: Iran says at least five tankers and a tugboat caught fire, several after hitting mines. Oil crossed $100 a barrel.

h: Iran lets Indian ships through the Strait of Hormuz
k: Indian vessels are exempt from Iran's shipping restrictions in the world's most important oil route — though they still pay a fee.

h: Delhi's air turns "severe" before Diwali
k: The capital's average AQI crossed 450 this week, and stricter GRAP-II curbs are now in force across the NCR.

h: Drone-delivery startup Zipline raises $1.5 billion
k: Its valuation has nearly tripled in about ten months, and Walmart is adding about 300 more drone-delivery locations.

h: Google plans a $17 billion AI data center in Wyoming
k: It will be Google's first in the state, powered largely by a giant fuel-cell plant.

h: Google, Meta and TikTok sue California over teen feeds law
k: The law limits autoplay and personalised feeds for users under 16. The companies say it breaks free-speech rules.

h: OpenAI's new AI found 81 serious Firefox bugs
k: A cybersecurity model for approved researchers is finding and helping fix software holes at a scale humans could not.

h: Airtel's profit jumps 24% as users pay more
k: Bharti Airtel's quarterly profit rose to ₹10,710 crore, helped by higher revenue per user.

h: LIC's profit rises 20% to ₹12,076 crore
k: India's biggest insurer had a strong September quarter, though new first-year premiums dipped slightly.

h: Microsoft pulls back, AI cloud stocks tumble
k: Microsoft passed on a bigger deal with Nscale and is tightening oversight of its AI cloud partners. Their shares fell sharply.

h: Palantir's revenue nearly doubles to $2.31 billion
k: The data and AI software company had its first $2 billion quarter and raised its outlook for the year.

h: India storm into the Asian Champions Trophy final
k: The defending champions beat South Korea 8-1 in the semi-final in Punjab to reach a record seventh final.

h: TRAI proposes separate licences for satellite internet
k: The telecom regulator wants satellite players under a new set of rules — and not selling directly to customers.

h: 40 US towns vote NO to AI data centers
k: Voters rejected new data-center projects, angry about power bills and pollution.

h: AMD plans $11 billion in AI acquisitions
k: A filing shows the chipmaker wants to buy World Labs and inference-chip startup Taalas.

h: Defence startup Shield AI buys Echodyne for $5.3 billion
k: The AI drone-pilot maker is buying a radar company and raising $2.5 billion at a $28.8 billion valuation.

h: Grubhub owner Wonder files to go public
k: Marc Lore's food company — which also owns Blue Apron — has confidentially filed for a US IPO.

h: India's services sector picks up speed in October
k: The HSBC India Services PMI rose to 55.8, showing faster growth in businesses like IT, banking, travel and retail.

h: Deepti Sharma in the race for ICC Player of the Month
k: The all-rounder was shortlisted after a match-winning show against Zimbabwe.

h: What to watch this weekend on OTT
k: Dulquer Salmaan's I'm Game, Netflix's Dilwali Diwali and a new season of Black Doves lead this week's releases.

h: Joyalukkas sets aside ₹100 crore for charity
k: The jewellery brand will fund homes, girls' education, elderly care and medical help.

h: Tata Trusts gave ₹1,556 crore — and plans up to 50 hospitals
k: The Trusts want a network of not-for-profit hospitals where those who can pay help cover those who can't.

h: Gene therapy helps blind patients see objects again
k: In a new trial, people blinded by an inherited eye disease could detect and find everyday objects.

h: A short truce in Ukraine got nearly 800 people to safety
k: A six-day ceasefire in the town of Oleshky let aid in and people out. More peace talks are planned next week.

h: Two teen brothers rescue a family from a flooded home
k: When emergency crews couldn't get through, they paddled in with a kayak and a paddleboard.

h: 8 tiger cubs bring new hope to a Rajasthan sanctuary
k: It's the first successful tiger breeding recorded at Kailadevi in nearly 30 years.

h: Saffron blooms on barren land in Ladakh
k: A pilot farm in Leh flowered in under a month and gave 22 grams of saffron in four days.

h: Bengal's "Foodman" runs 20+ free study centres for children
k: A college professor gives children free meals and free coaching across West Bengal.

h: This Bhopal café swaps your trash for a meal
k: Bring plastic, paper or household waste — walk out with food. 45 tonnes recycled so far.

h: IIT Bombay's free tool warns farmers of drought 4 weeks early
k: KrishiDrought uses satellites and AI to forecast dry soil for every district in India.

h: Students fill a football field with food for families in need
k: A New Jersey high school collected more than 250,000 pounds of food in one drive.
